cpmplus.w7view.sym.menu.desc: Shows the parts Blockbench's mirror brush does not paint and helps aligning them.
cpmplus.w7view.sym.title: Check symmetry
cpmplus.w7view.sym.help: Blockbench's mirror painting only paints a part when it finds its exact twin on the other side (x = 0). Use the mirror in Global/Model mode: on a CPM skin the left and right arm are in different places, and the 2D texture mode does not work. Only the X axis is checked.
cpmplus.w7view.sym.allPaired: All good: every part has a twin or sits in the middle.
cpmplus.w7view.sym.count: %s parts without a twin — the mirror does not paint them:
cpmplus.w7view.sym.tiny: %s pairs differ by less than 0.1 px
cpmplus.w7view.sym.btn.keepFirst: Align all (keep the left one of the list)
cpmplus.w7view.sym.btn.keepSecond: Align all (keep the right one of the list)
cpmplus.w7view.sym.diff.center: almost in the middle (centre at x = %s)
cpmplus.w7view.sym.diff.none: no similar twin on the other side (if it is asymmetric on purpose, mark it)
cpmplus.w7view.sym.note: Aligning only changes the position, size, inflate and rotation of the chosen part. It never touches UV, texture, parent groups or keyframes. The mirror also flips the UV inside the face: parts with per-face UV in another orientation can still paint the wrong pixel.
cpmplus.w7view.sym.confirmShape: This changes the shape or moves the part more than 0.25 px. Continue?
cpmplus.w7view.sym.notPaired: Could not align exactly — nothing was changed.
cpmplus.w7view.sym.noPainter: This Blockbench version has no mirror painting.
cpmplus.w7view.sym.badge: %s parts without a twin — the mirror does not paint them. Click to see.
